result.query:
SELECT TOP 1000 [MBusinessKey] AS [MBusinessKey], [HrefIndicatorDashboard] AS [HrefIndicatorDashboard], [DataGenerationDate] AS [DataGenerationDate], [MTypeName] AS [MTypeName], [MName] AS [MName], [Unit] AS [Unit], [AreaName] AS [AreaName], [LinkIndicatorDescription] AS [LinkIndicatorDescription], [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle] AS [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle], [DataSource] AS [DataSource], [Description] AS [Description], [DesiredValue] AS [DesiredValue], [InputType] AS [InputType], [Keywords] AS [Keywords], [MeasurePeriodInterval] AS [MeasurePeriodInterval] 
FROM (SELECT 
	  a.MBusinessKey
	  ,MTypeBusinessKey
	  ,MName
      ,[MTypeName]
      ,InputType
      ,AreaName
	  ,GroupTypeName
	  ,GroupName
	  ,Region
	    ,[semantic].[HrefIndicatorDashboard](
                                          'dataanalys.socialstyrelsen.se',
                                          URLslugDashboardTitle, 
                                          Unit, 
                                          UrlslugDashboard
        ) as HrefIndicatorDashboard 
      ,[semantic].[LinkAreaDashboard]('dataanalys.socialstyrelsen.se', URLslugStartpageDashboard) as LinkStartPageDashboard
      ,LinkStartPageDashboardTitle
      ,Unit
	  ,LinkIndicatorDescription
	  ,LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle
	  ,LinkAreaDescription
	  ,LinkAreaDescriptionTitle
	  ,mattenhet_kort
      ,Description
      ,TypeDescription
      ,DesiredValue
      ,DataSource
      ,[Keywords]
	  ,[MeasurementPeriodType]
      ,[FirstYear]
      ,[LastYear]
	  ,MeasurePeriodInterval
      ,LastValue
      ,FirstValue
      	  ,UnitChangeFirstValue
	  ,UnitChangePreviousValue
	  ,GrowthFirstValue
	  ,GrowthPreviousValue
	  ,DesiredGrowthFirstValue
	  ,DesiredGrowthPreviousValue
      ,UnitChangeFirstValueF
      ,UnitChangePreviousValueF
      ,GrowthFirstValueF
      ,GrowthPreviousValueF
	  ,GroupValueComparisonF
	  ,RankValueGroups
	  ,StdValueGroups
	  ,AvgValueGroups
      ,[DataGenerationDate]
    ,b.[order]
  FROM [semantic].[VAI_GONV_GroupStats_LastObs] a
  left join FileUploads.FileUploadGONVSortOrder b
  on a.MBusinessKey = b.MBusinessKey
) AS virtual_table 
WHERE [GroupTypeName] IN (N'Riket') GROUP BY [MBusinessKey], [HrefIndicatorDashboard], [DataGenerationDate], [MTypeName], [MName], [Unit], [AreaName], [LinkIndicatorDescription], [LinkIndicatorDescriptionTitle], [DataSource], [Description], [DesiredValue], [InputType], [Keywords], [MeasurePeriodInterval];
